    -- Parts directly in the inventory
    SELECT 
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id IN (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)

    UNION ALL

        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id,
        NULL AS color_id,
        iset.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    WHERE iset.inventory_id IN (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in the inventory
    SELECT 
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        NULL AS color_id,
        im.quantity AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    WHERE im.inventory_id IN (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
),

recursive_expansion AS (
    -- Base: all items at level 1
    SELECT 
        item_type,
        item_id,

            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'

    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = inv.id
